mentions.name: Canine
mentions.description: An open source platform that turns an existing Kubernetes cluster into a Heroku-like PaaS, making deployments user friendly with built-in support for teams and roles so small companies can run their own hosting without dedicated devops.
mentions.problem: Teams get stuck between not wanting to spend time on devops and being price gouged by Heroku: too big for deploy-to-a-VPS options like Coolify but too small to justify hiring a full-time DevOps, with no existing tool that just worked on their Kubernetes cluster.
mentions.audience: Teams and small startups that need app hosting without spending heavily on devops or hiring a full-time DevOps engineer
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on an open source tool that turns your Kubernetes into a Heroku like PaaS — https://canine.sh — for about two years
